wsrep_cluster_address.description: List of cluster node addresses in 'host:port' format. The arbitrator will connect to these nodes to participate in quorum decisions.

wsrep_node_name.description: Unique name for this arbitrator node — must not conflict with any Galera cluster node name.

log_path.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to syslog/stderr (recommended for systemd environments).

repl_connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on reconnecting to the cluster after disconnection. 0 means infinite retries.

extra_galera_options.description: List of custom Galera configuration options to append to the config. Use only if you need advanced tuning.
